relations: Celia；Mrs. Harper（校长秘书，本名 Madge，Celia 称她 Bertie 式人物）；B. Danvers（校长，信的作者）；Steve（收信人，未具名外方法律方）
numbers: 2 月 13 日投票；新生班每年一个 Donahue 博士后名额（前章）

facts.fact: Celia 在档案馆回味与 Harriot 的相遇：对方一直知道她是谁，她一开始就慢一步
facts.anchor: Call-me-Harry Harriot had known all along who I was.
facts.verbatim: Call-me-Harry Harriot had known all along who I was.

facts.fact: 门外地板吱呀，她拉门撞见 Mrs. Harper 跪着把纸往门缝塞
facts.anchor: Mrs. Harper, still kneeling, blinked up at me.
facts.verbatim: Mrs. Harper, still kneeling, blinked up at me.

facts.fact: Harper 用土腔声明「我什么都没给过你」：办公桌还在，坐那儿的就得是她
Harper 临走一句：这不只是图书馆发霉书的事，是山里人命关天的事
facts.anchor: This is people’s lives up here.
facts.verbatim: This is people’s lives up here.

facts.fact: 纸是打字信复写副本、未签名、出自校长办公桌，收信人 Steve
facts.anchor: It was a carbon copy of a typed letter.
facts.verbatim: It was a carbon copy of a typed letter.

facts.fact: 信写：Donahue 遗产是过渡里较棘手的一环，2 月 13 日投票前开放原件核验
facts.anchor: well ahead of the February 13 vote
facts.verbatim: well ahead of the February 13 vote
